pride_data.title: PfFBXO1 is essential for inner membrane complex formation in Plasmodium falciparum during both asexual and transmission stages
pride_data.projectDescription: Mass spectrometry data from PfFBXO1-TurboID proximity labeling in asexual schizonts and gametocytes.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: Following biotinylation, samples were saponin lysed, and parasite pellets were sonicated in RIPA buffer. Biotinylated proteins were isloated with streptavidin magnetic beads, washed in PBS and 80% ethanol, digested with trypsin, and then processed for mass spectrometry. Details in manuscript.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: Details of data processing protocols provided in the manuscript.
